*📊 Daily Sonnet Allowance*

Each user has a daily Sonnet allowance. After it is used, Nancy automatically continues on the custom model.

elements.text:
💡 *Usage Tips:* • Type `@nancy my quota` in any channel • Quotas reset at midnight UTC • Use 🍳 Keep Cooking for deeper analysis
Contact admin if you need more queries or talk for longer on my [customGPT](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-68a9ed2774fc819189474563060e76f4-nancy).

text.text:
*🔧 Connect Your Own Assistant to Nancy Brain*

Use the existing hosted microlensing knowledge base. Run `/mcp_api_key` here to receive your personal key, then connect your MCP client to:

`https://mcp.rges-pit.com/mcp`

Nancy accepts the key as `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer`. Client-specific setup for Codex, VS Code, Claude Code, and other clients is at <https://nancy.rges-pit.com/|nancy.rges-pit.com>.

Want to build a different knowledge base instead? See the <https://nancy-docs.malpas.nz/|Nancy Brain package documentation>.

*🚀 Quick Commands*

• `/mcp_api_key` - Get your Nancy Brain MCP API key
• *Custom GPT*: https://chatgpt.com/g/g-68a9ed2774fc819189474563060e76f4-nancy
• `@nancy my quota` - Check your daily usage
• `@nancy help` - Get general assistance
• 🍳 *Keep Cooking* button - Get deeper analysis when I finish a response
• Just ask questions naturally - I'll search my knowledge base automatically!
